hits.title: Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth | Scale AI
hits.snippet: # Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth By The Scale Team · July 30, 2026 · 3 min read Copy Link Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth Scale AI today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 10, 2026. The appointment comes as Scale's momentum accelerates, with customer growth across both its data and applications businesses. Recent wins include the addition of enterprise customers such as BP and Mayo Clinic, along with expanded business with both U.S. and international governments. Jason Droege, who has led the company as interim CEO since June 2025, will work closely with Francis over the coming months to help with the transition.
